set.approach: Bat Cave Buttress lies a little north of the Quartz Crack face and downhill. From Quartz Crack, follow the herd path north, losing a little height and continuing a few minutes beyond The Diagonal, until a low-angle slab with bolts runs off to the right of the path. You can also reach it by hiking up the herd path south from the ENT gully, or by climbing directly from the upper end of the notch parking lot, passing Biscuit. The route starts on that bolted slab where it touches down beside the herd path, shares its first two bolts with Steep Jugs, then breaks off right.

review.notes: Area page: herd-path approach to the buttress; route page: start on the slab beside the path, shares first two bolts with Steep Jugs. No descent stated.
